limitation_observed: The prior 1-s right-source organism accumulated only -0.0228 deg signed motor command versus 0.1574 deg absolute command, and bearing error worsened by 3.77 deg. Its raw command changed sign 8 times.
operation: Run the same 166700-neuron full organism and MuJoCo body for 2000 ms after 40 ms odor-free preparation. Apply one fixed causal motor EMA plus symmetric threshold at output and one physical thorax-yaw wind torque over trial steps 1001..1020. No source-bearing information enters the motor policy.
legal_information: Previously exposed 1-s right-source trace, existing prepared geometry, the prior body-only torque pulse and existing 5-deg/s controller envelope. The 2-s filtered/wind outcome is unseen.

rivals.A: The filtered sign provides a sustained useful turn; after wind, bearing error recovers toward the source.
rivals.B: The filter acts but direction/strength is insufficient; bearing error persists or worsens.
rivals.C: The wind/body integration or neural clock leaves the numerical/support domain; biological interpretation stops.

controls_and_limit: One exploratory intervention arm only. The unmodified 1-s run is contextual evidence, not a matched 2-s control. Stage4/5 remains open until a same-start unfiltered and sham/yoked perturbation comparison.

fixed_inputs.source_design: lateral offset 1.5 antenna baselines; sigma 1.5 baselines; forward offset is the unique nonnegative solution that matches the old prepared bilateral mean

preflight.guard_basis: Seven already exposed Stage3 prepared poses: maximum common pair discrepancy 4.0118686151e-11 and prior-common discrepancy 2.0018653402e-11. The 1e-10 bounds are input/pose identity tolerances, not a change to neural, motor or numerical-effect criteria.

observation.scope: Raw per-ms body, sensors, DN, signed flow, raw and filtered motor, and wind dose; bounded adapter observations.

screen.meaning: A positive screen only triggers matched controls; it is not a Stage4 pass. A negative screen rejects delayed bearing correction for this arm and horizon.

stop: Do not tune the filter, threshold, gain, torque or source after observing this run. Preserve failures and logs; do not call this Stage5 causal proof.

wind.implementation: mj_applyFT each 25us MuJoCo substep; no pose teleport
wind.note: 100x the prior verified tiny pulse; realized angular displacement is measured, not assumed
